label: keyref-1
brief: A 16-second widescreen ad for Petal & Stem, a small neighbourhood flower shop: the florist opens the shop at dawn and arranges a bouquet, then hands it to a smiling customer at the door; warm, natural light; end on the shop front.

llm.name: keyref-screenplay-v1
llm.purpose: screenplay as clip batches + element table

gate.why: The brief describes an invented ad scenario; Petal & Stem has no specified real-world identity or storefront that must be reproduced.

story.style: 16-second widescreen live-action ad; close-ups and a gentle pullback, with warm, natural dawn light.
story.story:
Dawn light falls across Petal & Stem on Alder Street. Mara, wearing a green apron, unlocks the Petal & Stem door with a brass key and pushes it open. A brass doorbell gives a bright ring.

Inside Petal & Stem, quick close-ups follow Mara’s hands over a wooden counter. Mara gathers pink tulips and white daisies into a bouquet, folds cream paper around the stems, and ties a blue ribbon around the cream paper. Sunlight catches the petals as Mara lifts the bouquet from the wooden counter.

At the Petal & Stem door, Eli smiles. Mara places the bouquet into Eli’s waiting hands. Eli curls both hands around the cream paper, with the blue ribbon hanging over Eli’s fingers.

The camera draws back onto Alder Street. The final shot holds on the Petal & Stem shopfront in warm dawn light. Above the open Petal & Stem door, the shop sign reads: “Petal & Stem.”
story.title: Petal & Stem at Dawn

beats.action: One uninterrupted, locked medium-close shot from just outside the threshold, angled toward the door lock and the shallow wooden counter immediately inside. Mara turns a brass key, pushes the door inward, and steps behind the counter; the brass bell rings. Keep the door open.

Mara gathers the small, loose cluster of pink tulips and white daisies lying on precreased cream paper. In one practiced sequence, she folds the paper around the stems and ties the blue ribbon with a simple snug knot, leaving two long tails. Her hands and the flowers dominate the foreground; dawn sunlight catches the petals.
Mara lifts the finished bouquet toward the open doorway. Eli steps into the right edge of the frame, smiling and raising both empty hands. End before the handover begins.

clips.summary: Widescreen 16:9 live-action photography with warm natural dawn light, tactile detail, gentle movement, and an intimate neighbourhood-ad feeling. The shop has a sage-green timber frontage, a cream fascia bearing the dark-green words “Petal & Stem,” an inward-opening glazed door with brass hardware and a brass bell, and a shallow wooden counter immediately inside the left jamb. The bouquet has pink tulips and white daisies wrapped in cream paper, secured with a blue ribbon with two long tails. Mara is a dark-haired woman in her thirties wearing a moss-green apron over an ivory shirt with rolled sleeves. Eli is a short-haired adult in their thirties wearing a pale-blue overshirt over a white T-shirt. Mara opens the shop and makes the bouquet in a single close, stationary composition.
clips.sound: Quiet dawn birds and distant neighbourhood ambience, a key click, one bright brass doorbell ring, paper rustling, and soft acoustic instrumental music; no speech.
clips.ends_on: The door is open inward. Mara stands just inside at the left-hand counter, holding the completed bouquet at chest height, flowers upright and ribbon tails hanging down. Eli stands at the right side of the threshold, smiling with both hands raised but not yet touching the bouquet. The camera remains just outside the doorway.

states.state: The door starts closed and locked, then stays open inward; warm dawn illumination remains constant.
Loose pink tulips and white daisies on cream paper become one finished bouquet with a tied blue ribbon; the finished bouquet ends in Mara's hands.
Unlocks the door with a brass key, steps behind the nearby counter, wraps the flowers, and lifts the finished bouquet.
Enters the right edge only at the end, smiling with empty hands raised to receive the bouquet.

beats.action: Continue directly from the supplied last frame without resetting anyone. Mara extends the bouquet the remaining short distance into Eli's waiting hands. Eli curls both hands around the cream paper; the blue ribbon tails fall over their fingers. Mara releases her grip, and Eli's smile broadens. The camera initially holds.

Make one gentle, straight backward camera move onto Alder Street, widening naturally from the doorway and bouquet to the complete shopfront. Mara remains just inside the doorway; Eli stays beside the threshold holding the bouquet. The cream fascia and its sign become fully visible as the camera retreats.
Stop and hold the warm, sunlit shopfront, with the open door, both people, and Eli's bouquet clearly visible. Above them, the sign reads exactly “Petal & Stem.”
